chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa'dan, from Abu Baseer, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who is killed in the Way of Allah, Allah will not introduce him to anything from his sins.'

key_terms.سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: The Way of Allah (in the context of jihad or striving)
key_terms.سَيِّئَاتِهِ: His sins (specifically minor sins in this context)
key_terms.يُعَرِّفْهُ: He will make him know / introduce him to / present to him

ai.seo_question: What happens to a martyr's sins according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to emphasize the comprehensive mercy granted to martyrs, specifically noting that Allah conceals their minor sins (sayyiat) from the public reckoning. This highlights the Shia understanding of martyrdom not merely as physical death, but as a spiritual elevation where divine grace overrides the strict accounting of lesser faults, reinforcing the virtue of dying in the path of God.
